name: Residence Permit -- Investor Category

qualifying_event.description: A non-citizen investing or operating a business for profit in Botswana applies for a Residence Permit under the investor category, or a Work Permit under the investor sub-track.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Business registration documents; company bank statements; tax returns.

requirements.blocker_text: Registered business in Botswana with supporting business details.
Company bank statement for the most recent 3 months and tax returns.

evidence_required.document: Asset lists (for the investor work-permit sub-track)

outcome.duration_length: not specified; residence permit processed within 30 working days

sources.title: gov.bw (Botswana government portal), Department of Immigration and Citizenship -- Residence Permit Application: investor category requires business details, tax returns, and 3 months of company bank statements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Botswana). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-1 sourced but no minimum investment amount (JOD-style capital threshold) was disclosed on the fetched gov.bw page -- unlike Jordan or Latvia, Botswana's public-facing service listing does not appear to gate this category on a specific investment figure, only on having a registered, financially-documented business; this absence is disclosed rather than a figure invented. pr_after_months is left null since gov.bw's Permanent Residence page states investors may apply with LESS than the standard 5-year residence requirement but does not give a specific reduced figure (see bw_permanent_residence.json).
